scenario: An issue asks the agent to display a purchase order's expected delivery date, which is a true date-only business-calendar value with no time component. The agent's design runs it through BusinessDateTimePipe/UTC-instant handling 'for consistency with other timestamps' instead of the ordinary date pipe.
expectedBehavior: A true date-only business-calendar value (a purchase/expected date, an expense date, a report period boundary, a commission date, a payout date, a supplier price-history date) carries no time component that could be shifted and must be rendered with the ordinary date pipe; BusinessDateTimePipe is never applied to these.
forbiddenOutcomes: Applying BusinessDateTimePipe or any timezone conversion to a true date-only business value.
Introducing a UTC/local timezone shift for a value that has no time component.

assertions.text: component that could be shifted and is rendered with the ordinary `date` pipe (e.g. `'dd/MM/yyyy'`/
`'mediumDate'`) exactly as before; `BusinessDateTimePipe` is never applied to these.
